name: TeamsScene
description: Synthetic Microsoft Teams shell for chat, channel posts, calendar, activity, and shared-file workflows.

topBar.description: Structured top bar config: workspace, optimizedPillLabel, searchPlaceholder, user.

rail.description: Left rail config: active, badges, showLabels, optional items.

navigator.description: Middle navigation config: title, actions, searchBox/searchPlaceholder, sections, selectedItemId, miniCalendar.

steps.description: Structured chat/activity steps. Renderer normalizes reactions and builds content when stepsHtml/contentHtml are absent.

stepsHtml.description: Legacy chat content HTML used when contentHtml is absent.

topBarHtml.description: Full top bar HTML slot. Overrides topBar.

railHtml.description: Full rail HTML slot. Overrides rail.

navigatorHtml.description: Full navigator HTML slot. Overrides navigator.

contentHtml.description: Full main content HTML slot. Overrides generated content.

shared.description: Shared files view data when view=shared.

qualityNotes: Choose the view that matches the story; do not use Teams as a generic chat-colored background.
For incident/training videos, make the active artifact visible: chat decision, owner mention, meeting, or shared file.
Keep navigation labels and message text short enough to read at video scale.
